title: Taiwanese American Association East San Gabriel Valley 洛杉磯聖東台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association East San Gabriel Valley (洛杉磯聖東台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the East San Gabriel Valley area of Los Angeles County, California, a region that has long been home to a significant concentration of Taiwanese Americans in communities such as Hacienda Heights, Rowland Heights, Walnut, and Diamond Bar. The chapter is listed under the TAA’s Western (美西) regional division.
